messages:
Samira: Heads-up — support ticket #5482 from SmallCap Labs flagged a 70% drop in API calls since 3/10, plus repeated embedding mismatches. I'm escalating to CS because they're on a quarterly renewal in 3 weeks and usage decline looks like churn risk.

Maya: Thanks for raising. Do we have root cause yet? Any billing spikes or rate limits showing?

Samira: No billing spikes. Logs show 429s avoided, but many 200s with empty embed vectors. Link: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/5482. Error snippet:
```
embed_service: returned empty vector for doc_id=98345
```

Ezra: Product thinks it's a new model quantization edge — apparently when sequence length > 4096 the prefix truncation path returns blanks. Patch in review, ETA 48 hrs.

Liam: CS play — propose immediate outreach: 1) confirm impact + compensate with 30k token credit, 2) schedule 1:1 onboarding touch with Solutions (Maya), 3) propose canary switch to alternate model until patch is live. Agree?

Maya: Agree. I'll draft the outreach and offer the training session. Can someone confirm credits + whether we can enable model fallback for their org?

Samira: Support can toggle fallback to v2-lite now (non-breaking). I'll coordinate the switch and post back when done.

Ezra: Patch merged to staging. I'll ping infra to promote if fallback causes issues. ETA promoting tonight.

Maya: Comm plan: I'll send an email to the customer within 2 hours explaining the find, include remediation steps, offer credits, and book a call. @Liam can you confirm approval for the 30k token credit? If approved I'll mark renewal as 'at risk' in Salesforce and set a weekly check-in.

Liam: Approved. Mark renewal at-risk and add a follow-up in 7 days. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Ticket #5482 status changed: fallback toggled to v2-lite by Samira at 1745556780.

Maya: Great — once fallback confirmed I'll send the email and add notes to CS handoff doc. Anyone else to loop in? Exec sponsor from our side (if they ask): Ezra can provide tech brief.

Samira: Fallback confirmed — traffic now back to expected volumes. Customer responded asking for timeline; scheduled call for tomorrow 10am PT.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll post the outreach copy to the private CS thread after sending. Closing internal escalation for now but keeping renewal watch.
